items.title: Unauthenticated GET /uploads/* served health files
items.reproduction: See evidence/ra00-001-before.json — status 200, file bytes, Cache-Control public max-age=604800, no Authorization.
items.rootCause: express.static(UPLOAD_DIR, { maxAge: '7d' }) mounted at /uploads before auth. UUID filename treated as access control.
items.fix: denyLegacyPublicUploads on /uploads; GET /api/files/:filename with requireAuth + MedicalRecord owner check; private no-store headers; mobile Image uses Bearer; unlink on record/account delete.

items.title: Universal QA OTP reachable whenever AppSettings.qaOtpEnabled is true
items.fix: isQaOtpEnabled() returns false when NODE_ENV==='production' regardless of env code or settings. qaOtpEnabledForEnv unit-tested.
